description_html:
For Apple iPad/iPad Pro/Air/mini (White)

Anker Pencil is compatible with the iPad Pro 12.9-inch (third generation or later), iPad Pro 11-inch (first generation or later), iPad Air (third generation or later), iPad (sixth generation or newer), and iPad mini (fifth generation or newer).

The stylus for iPad from Anker should connect to the tablet via Bluetooth 5.3. It supports tilt sensitivity but not pressure sensitivity. When not in use, the pen can be attached to the side of compatible iPads with its integrated N52 neodymium magnet. The battery life is specified as 8 hours, and the charging time via USB-C connection with 25 minutes. Wireless charging is not possible.
